newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela November inflation seen at 3 pct - Matos.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela November inflation seen at 3 pct - Matos.

text.p: Venezuelan inflation in November will fall to around three percent from October's 4.2 percent level, Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar said.
October's inflation figures was a blip, Matos said. "Inflation will continue to fall ... (in November) it will be at around three percent," he told reporters.
State-owned oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PdVSA) recently forecast November inflation at 2.7 percent.
